title: Oregon vs Michigan State: 1st Quarter Point Spread

content.value: This market resolves to Yes if Oregon covers a -3.5 point spread against Michigan State during the 1st quarter of the College Football game between Oregon and Michigan State scheduled for November 20, 2026 at 8:00 PM ET, meaning Oregon scores more than 3.5 points more than Michigan State during the 1st quarter. Otherwise, it resolves to No. The Underlying counts only points scored by each team during the 1st quarter, as documented by the official quarter-by-quarter scoring summary. Source Agencies, in order, are the league governing body, ESPN, Fox Sports, and the broadcast partner of the event. If the Expiration Value cannot be determined on the Expiration Date (including because the game is cancelled or a team forfeits, withdraws, or is disqualified), the Exchange may determine payouts pursuant to the Market Outcome Review Process.
